tokens.name: logo-navy
tokens.usage: Exact navy sampled from the logo (UV, gear arms, tagline). Brand reference only: use it through `primary` and `surface-deep`, never re-tint it.

tokens.name: logo-sky
tokens.usage: Exact sky blue sampled from the logo (GULF, gear ring). Fills, icons, rules and display type 24px+. Too light for body text on white (3.1:1).

tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Deepest navy. Footer ground; text on `sky` fills in dark theme.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Hero and feature-band ground.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of `logo-navy` fills.

tokens.name: sky-600
tokens.usage: Readable sky: links and focus ring on light grounds (6.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Readable sky on navy grounds: links, eyebrows, focus ring in dark theme.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Pale sky tint for selected rows and info panels in light theme.

tokens.name: signal-500
tokens.usage: Inspection-tag amber, the one warm hue. Small highlights only: the eyebrow tick, the 'certified' marker, warning state. Never a large fill or button colour.

tokens.name: steel-50
tokens.usage: Cool off-white, tinted toward navy.

tokens.name: steel-200
tokens.usage: Hairline grey.

tokens.name: steel-500
tokens.usage: Mid steel for control borders on white.

tokens.name: steel-700
tokens.usage: Dark steel for secondary text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands, form panels, table stripes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and the header bar when it sits on `surface-alt`.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Hero, the Inspection/Training split, footer. Always paired with `on-deep` text; stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Info panels, selected filter chips, active nav item background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `surface-raised`, `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `surface-raised`, `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-deep` and `primary` (light theme).

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-deep`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active states. Navy in light theme, sky in dark so it stays visible on dark grounds.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover`. Dark ink in dark theme, never white on sky.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sky marks: icons, rules, the gear motif, card top edges, display numerals 24px+. Not for body text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Amber marker: eyebrow tick, certification seal, the 'certified' dot. Shapes only; text on it is `on-signal`.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders; meets 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-alt`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable element; 3:1+ on all surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid certificate, sent enquiry. Text and icon on `surface`/`surface-alt`; always with the word 'Valid' and a check icon.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a success result panel.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expired certificate, service unavailable. Text on `surface`, `warning-bg`; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning result panel.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Not found / invalid certificate, form errors. Text on `surface`, `danger-bg`; always with a word and icon.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of an error result panel.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. Drop to `display-l` under 720px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title on service and course pages. 32px under 720px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small card titles, form section titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading. Paired with the amber tick.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Third-party inspection, testing, calibration and technical advisory across the Kingdom.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We calibrate pressure, temperature, dimensional, electrical and gas instruments on-shore and off-shore.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Our team mobilises from Khobar to sites across Saudi Arabia.
styles.usage: Card text, footer text, form hints.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Certificate numbers, standard references, method codes (UT, RT, MT).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to input, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, input padding, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, method chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards. Echoes the softened corners of the logo lettering.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, the verification result, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the certified seal only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Header bar when scrolled; inputs on focus.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card hover, dropdown menus, chatbot panel.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Content width on desktop.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for running text.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height on desktop; 64px on mobile.
